abstract.p: This paper categorizes SR manipulator singularities and geometries based on genericity. A novel recursive application of screw theory is used to generate singular configurations and provide a geometric interpretation of non-genericity. A generic manipulator classification scheme based on homotopy class is introduced. Non-generic geometries are interpreted as bifurcations of generic geometries with respect to kinematic parameter values. Some conjectures on the classes of manipulators which can change pose without passing through a singularity are also given.
